football_evidence.question: Can Massachusetts take away UConn’s big plays?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.4 points.
supporting: When Massachusetts has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Massachusetts’ offense has allowed a sack on 5.2% of its dropbacks, and UConn’s defense sacks the quarterback on 9.1% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
When UConn has the ball (the run game against the run defense): UConn’s offense averages 6.4 yards per carry, and Massachusetts’ defense allows 4.6 yards per carry (FBS average 5.1).

When UConn has the ball (big plays through the air): UConn’s offense turns 16.4% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Massachusetts’ defense gives up explosive gains on 5.0% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When Massachusetts has the ball (big plays on the ground): Massachusetts’ offense turns 6.5% of its runs into explosive gains, and UConn’s defense gives up explosive gains on 4.6% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).
contradicting: When UConn has the ball (big plays on the ground): UConn’s offense turns 7.4% of its runs into explosive gains, and Massachusetts’ defense gives up explosive gains on 3.6% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Massachusetts has the ball (the red zone): Massachusetts’ offense succeeds on 54.8% of its red-zone plays, and UConn’s defense allows success on 39.5% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Massachusetts’ secondary No. 36 nationally and UConn’s No. 62.
quarterbacks: Kalieb Osborne has completed 97 of 164 passes (59.1%) for 1,433 yards, 8.7 yards per attempt, 10 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in six games for UConn, and has been sacked on 17 of 181 dropbacks.

William Watson III has completed 74 of 100 passes (74.0%) for 820 yards, 8.2 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in five games for Massachusetts, and has been sacked on 4 of 104 dropbacks.
Aedan McCarthy has completed 17 of 33 passes (51.5%) for 182 yards, 5.5 yards per attempt, no touchdowns and no interceptions in two games for Massachusetts, and has been sacked on 2 of 35 dropbacks.
